title: Initiative Weave: Q3 Hosted API + Model Catalog Roadmap
creator: Ava Martinez
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog Cohort Strategy
description: Define a cohesive quarterly roadmap that stitches together hosted API product priorities and model catalog operational work into a single phased plan ("initiative weave") so engineering, research, and operations can execute predictable rollouts, experiments, and retirement lanes. Deliverables include an OKR-aligned milestone map, risk-backed contingency lanes, clear canary gating criteria, and a cross-functional delivery checklist for Q3 hosted endpoint launches and model rotations.
goals: Align hosted API capacity and model catalog onboarding to top-level Q3 OKRs: reduce avg tail latency by 15% and reduce per-token cost by 10%
Establish a 3-lane release fabric (canary / cohort / wide) with documented gating for quality and cost
Produce an operations playbook for model rotations that includes rollback triggers, traffic routing policies, and observability dashboards
Create an initiative-level OKR mapping that ties each milestone to owner, signal metrics, and risk tolerance

2026-03-24: Draft initiative weave diagram and lane definitions published to Confluence
2026-04-07: Canary gating criteria finalized (latency, regen-rate, quality deltas)
2026-04-21: Capacity simulation and surge hedging attached to initiative (ops signoff)
2026-05-05: Final roadmap published with release windows and rollback windows
2026-05-15: OKR assignment closed and handoff to execution cycles
risks: Model quality regressions during cohort rollouts could increase false positives in downstream rerankers (mitigation: eval suites + shadow traffic)
Capacity shortfall if demand surge exceeds Q3 forecast (mitigation: pre-booked Dedicated burst lanes + priority routing)
Cross-team coordination overhead delaying gating approvals (mitigation: weekly gating sync and clear arbiter roles)
Observability gaps for new model variants leading to blindspots (mitigation: dashboard template + trace hooks required before canary)

ENG-9124: Streaming telemetry hooks for variant-level latency breakdowns
